meta.name: skill-router
meta.description: The index of every pro-workflow skill and command, grouped by job, with when to reach for each and whether it is human-run or auto-triggered. Use when you are not sure which skill fits, want the full map, or ask "what can this do", "which skill for X", "list the workflow".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what_en: When you are unsure which skill to use, Claude lists all skills and commands grouped by job, indicating whether each is human-invoked or auto-triggered.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "what can this do", "which skill for X", "list the workflow", or when you are not sure which skill fits.
